summary: A review is named by a topic, not a theme. The file is `.tabthrough.{topic}.guide.json`. Defaults come from the branch or the first words of the commit, not the whole subject. Focusing the file starts the walk; Tab writes `cursor` back.

.tabthrough.guide-topic.guide.json.rationale: This sidecar, written into the tree it describes

.tabthrough-guide.json.rationale: Stale walk for an earlier idle-path change

res/skill/tabthrough/SKILL.md.rationale: Authoring copy of the topic-path contract

schema/guide-v1.json.rationale: Published echo of the reader you walk

test/unit/topic.test.ts.rationale: Unit coverage of the helpers you just read

src/guide/serialize.ts.rationale: Passes topic through; generate is the consumer

steps.title: .tabthrough.{topic}.guide.json
steps.rationale: The label every later write and focus check uses
steps.notes: A typed topic may be 48 characters. A suggested topic is four words, 32 characters, and drops a conventional-commit prefix so a long subject does not become the filename.

steps.title: topic and cursor are optional fields
steps.rationale: The document shape the filename contract is stored in
steps.notes: Agents omit `cursor`. A path-like topic or a cursor outside −1…499 fails the whole document.

steps.title: Defaults from branch or first words
steps.rationale: First consumer — the field you saw filled with a truncated subject

steps.title: Simple writes the topic sidecar
steps.rationale: Same topic atom, now on disk and opened

steps.title: Start jumps to the stored step
steps.rationale: Restore before the session is published, so persist sees the landed cursor
steps.notes: Only an explicit topic sidecar path is stored on the session. A heuristic start does not bind `.tabthrough-guide.json`.

steps.title: Tab writes cursor back to the file
Focusing a topic guide starts the walk
steps.rationale: The entry the filename and cursor were built for

steps.title: Skill install appends .tabthrough*
steps.rationale: Sidecars stay out of commits unless someone force-adds them

steps.title: Topic field on the generate screen
steps.rationale: The reviewer can rename the file before Generate
